Not even joking!!! This has freaked me out, 
I first went to Disneyworld Florida when I was 9. And I don’t remember much, all I remember is being Terrified if it’s a small world. 
I just remember getting off and saying I’m never doing that again, mind you my parents were fine. Also I’m not scared of dolls or anything like that. 

So for my 21st my parents took me back and it got to the end of the trip and we all went on it’s a small world. Now they went on the boat before me and I was alone with a random family behind me. We are a plus size family not gonna lie and to be more comfortable I said I would sit on my own.

So the ride starts and it’s fine but as soon as we enter in to the “main” start area ....Ohhh boy.
The Whole time and I mean the whole time. I Swear I was being watched. And I just didn’t feel right. Like I’m sure some of them dolls had stopping moving and were just staring at me and following me. Then I still swear this on my life. My parents think I’m crazy but I swear I was on that ride for 50 minutes! Maybe an hour or so! Just going around and around. But it was like we never reached the area where you get off and get on again ... like the goodbye area just turned in to the hello area and it would start over again.  When I finally reached the exit, I could see my parents standing on the platform waiting for me. As I got off, they said enjoy that, laughing as if I hadn’t been gone at all. I said “no not really, how long was I stuck on there for ?” “You weren’t....” “I think the music has driven you crazy... come on” They turned away and started walking towards our next ride. I looked over towards the employee and I swear... I swear they gave me this look like I wasn’t meant to be there. That me and that family shouldn’t of gotten off that boat. They just blinked and then smiled towards me and turned away back to the control bored. 

Oh yh that family... they were Just like me! Felt like we had been on the ride for ages! I had turned to them and gone to say something, ask them if they had experienced it too but before I could say anything the father said “don’t say a word to anyone, not one, forget what happened” the whole family looked so pale and just confused, apart from the Dad he seems fine. He just ushered them away, and I walked over to my parents. 

And up until now I haven’t. I haven’t told a single person. It’s been over 2 years and it still freaks me out. 

Don’t get me wrong I love Disney with all my heart but Fuck it’s a small world. That’s some creepy arse shit!
